title: Ullam Kollai Poguthae
desc: Anbu, a mimicry artist, falls for his sister's friend Jyothi, who is in love with Gautham. Just when they are about to get married, an accident changes the course of their lives forever.

title: Madhumathi
desc: A researcher ventures into the jungle in search of an ancient script that is protected by a snake. However, she faces a hurdle in the form of a white snake that tries to kill her.

title: Anantha Poongatre
desc: Jeeva falls for widow Meena and admires her past, but is forced to marry Divya when her father kidnaps Meena's son, using him as leverage to threaten Jeeva into the marriage.

title: Kannamoochi Yenada
desc: A man loves a girl and tries to woo her parents but then his uncle ruins his plans.

title: Tenaliraman
desc: Tenali Raman, a clever jester, has a mission to set things right in a corrupt kingdom.
